_defect_found: q13 slot 9, caught by READING THE RENDER after the gate and the clean render had both passed. Seed 1 drew its sample from the city VOTER REGISTRATION ROLL and then named that same frame as the flaw for the student to find - while the question text asserts that every member of the population had an equal chance of being selected. The prompt contradicted itself, and a student answering 'the sampling was not done well' would have been right about the question and wrong about the rubric. Fixed by moving seed 1 to a complete resident address list and giving it a leading-question threat instead, which also keeps the three threat types distinct (timing / leading question / nonresponse). qsetid 1895083 was UPDATED IN PLACE, never re-filed. Neither the lint, the byte-exact read-back, the qtype audit nor the clean render caught it.
